bullets.title: The Perils of Audience Capture
bullets.creator: Gurwinder Bhogal
bullets.note: ([@G\_S\_Bhogal](https://twitter.com/G_S_Bhogal)). **Everyone should read this brilliant piece.** It could alternatively be titled “How Influencers Become Caricatures with No Exit,” “How Anyone Online Can Lose Themselves,” or “Succumbing to Quicksand: Digital Identity Creep in the 2020s.” If you spend any time online, you are subject to the dynamics described in this article. Read it, even if only for preemptive planning. I chat so often with friends about these things that one texted me this today: “Holy shit. Reading now. Has this guy been reading our texts?”

bullets.title: This is Water
bullets.note: commencement speech by [David Foster Wallace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Foster_Wallace), which he gave at Kenyon College on May 21, 2005. It is [also available in book form](https://www.amazon.com/This-Water-Delivered-Significant-Compassionate/dp/0316068225), but I highly recommend the audio. Past podcast guest [Dr. Peter Attia](https://tim.blog/2021/06/08/peter-attia-2/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) listens to this every two weeks, which is how it first crossed my radar.

bullets.title: Vengeance
bullets.note:
I loved this film and laughed so hard that I made people uncomfortable. Give it 10–15 minutes to really warm up. Here’s the description: “_Vengeance_, the directorial debut from writer and star [B.J. Novak](https://tim.blog/2015/11/25/bj-novak/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) ([@bjnovak](https://mobile.twitter.com/bjnovak)) (_The Office_), is a darkly comic thriller about Ben Manalowitz, a journalist and podcaster who travels from New York City to West Texas to investigate the death of a girl he was hooking up with.” The dialogue in this entire movie is hilarious. At least [watch the trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1GT1jFsNnPw), and here’s one sample exchange from a dinner in Abilene, TX:  
​  
​**Ty**: “There’s something you gotta know about this place, Ben. This is the most wretched, godforsaken stretch of land on the face of the earth—and I’d never leave. Know what I mean?”  
​  
​**Ben**: “Yeah. That’s how I feel about Twitter.”
